observations: Stainless steel microwave oven with a glass door and control panel on the right side.
Photo 0 shows the door closed; photos 1-3 show the door open with a glass turntable and interior rack visible.
Control panel includes a large rotary knob, several push buttons, and a small digital display window.
A decal on the door glass in photo 0 reads 'TECH HOME APPLIANCES' but appears to be a sticker rather than a nameplate.
Faint text at the bottom front in photos 1-3 is not clearly legible as a brand or model.

claims.evidence: Cleanliness is supported by the photos, but imported status cannot be verified remotely; no origin markings or documents are visible in photos 0-3.
Photos show a microwave interior but cannot confirm separate oven or grill functions.
No video or demonstration of operation is provided in photos 0-3.

risks.risk: Microwave does not heat or turntable does not rotate
risks.proof: Video of the unit running with a cup of water inside

risks.risk: Door seal, latch, or hinges are faulty
risks.proof: Close-up video of the door closing and latch engaging
risks.if_unproven: as not working or needing repair

risks.risk: Grill or oven functions are non-functional
risks.proof: Seller demonstrates the grill setting or shows a specification label
risks.if_unproven: as microwave only, without grill or oven value

risks.risk: Internal components such as the magnetron or wiring are damaged
risks.proof: Video of operation and close-up of the interior cavity and rear vents

proof_requests: Video of the microwave operating with the door closed (turntable rotating, interior light on, heating).
Close-up photo of any rating label, brand plate, or model number on the unit.
Demonstration of the grill or oven function if claimed.
response.reason: The item is clearly a microwave oven and can be priced at its worst case (not working) based on the photos; unproven claims do not prevent a worst-case price.
